title: Quiet Goodbye
description: Logging out should be a no-drama operation even if the session is already gone — a crew member closing a stale tab shouldn't get an error just because their cookie expired first.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/logout with no th_refresh cookie present at all returns 204 with an empty body, exactly like calling it with a valid cookie does. A subsequent attempt to refresh using a refresh token that was already logged out (once, from a prior valid session) returns 401.
hints: Logout deliberately doesn't distinguish "already logged out" from "successfully logged out" — both return 204, per the service's missing/unknown-token-is-ignored behavior.
To set up the second assertion, log in, capture the refresh cookie, call logout once with it, then try to refresh with that same now-revoked token.
